# Reference aggregate fixture (`Products`)

The declarative model of the reference aggregate used by the golden-output regression test and
the E2E harness. `{Aggregate}` tokens in paths and file contents are replaced with the aggregate
name (`Products`) when the sandbox is materialized by
`Lazy.Crud.Builder.Platform.Tool sandbox create`.

Layout: `<Layer>/…` is copied into `src/<Aggregate>/<Aggregate>.<Layer>/…` of the sandbox. The
layer projects, wrapper templates (`DefaultEntities.tt`, `DefaultCommands.tt`, …), test projects,
`lazy.settings`, `nuget.config` and the solution are generated by the tool from the canonical
consumer layout (`AggregateLayout`), which mirrors what the Visual Studio extension creates.

The exact regeneration command is recorded in `tests/golden/README.md`.
